## Window
Round 1, the final round and the post-mortem for the run. Window 2026-10-15T21:38:40 to 2026-10-16T02:05:11 (+01:00), though all board activity is in seqs 1–27, about 21:39–21:41. Live now: 0 solvers and 0 supervisors (I am the only supervisor). No knob had been tuned before this round. There is no previous window to compare against.

## Succession
- 4 handoff requests, 3 real handoffs (for example seq 22 from sol-001), 2 stubs, 2 kills.
- Handoff success rate is 0.6 (n=5), with no baseline. Median time from request to handoff was 5.64 s.
- No earlier tune to evaluate.
- Lineages L-002 and L-003 reached generation 3 and L-001 generation 2. For a pack of 8 tasks finished in about 2 minutes, that is churn: each solver burned through its context in only a few tasks.
- The stub successors did not redo work: duplicate_rate is 0 (n=7). sol-003-g3 finished T-007 by building on seqs 12–20.

## Queue and SLOs
- Tasks: 8 done, 0 open, 0 leased, 0 blocked. Verifier mean score 0.946.
- SLOs, all first-window values:
  - completions_per_mtok 2.73 (n=8)
  - blocked_failed_rate 0 (n=8)
  - duplicate_rate 0 (n=7)
  - lease_wait_median_s 15.4 (n=8)
  - handoff_success_rate 0.6 (n=5)
- Lowest scores:
  - T-005 scored 0.667. years_between was 1 where 2 was expected (seq 17/20, corrected at seq 21).
  - T-007 scored 0.9; it was missing the "michaelmas" keyword. "Michaelmas" appeared in seq 17, but the chronicle (seq 26) left it out.
- Throughput and queue health were good. Succession was the only weak SLO.

## Actions taken
- Votes:
  - +1 on seq 21: the correct years_between convention.
  - −1 on seq 17: its convention was scored wrong.
  - +1 on seq 22: an exemplary handoff.
  - All three returned weight 0 because no solvers are live. They are a record only.
- No tune. Solvers are gone, any tune would expire at its TTL before another solver ran, and there is no previous window for hysteresis. Had solvers been live, I would have lowered handoff_pct from 80 to 70 (slo handoff_success_rate, 2 kills of 5 successions).
- No blockers, alerts or reopens. No ping: the succession_failing trigger needs kills in two windows, and only one exists.

## Diagnosis
- **sol-003 (L-003 gen 1, T-007):** I confirm no_chance, with a note. The request landed at 87% context, and the kill came 2.72 s later with zero turns and zero tool calls in between. The next turn crossed kill_pct before the agent could act. The root cause is the same as never_asked: one turn can add more than the gap between handoff_pct and kill_pct. The request arrived when the agent was already at 87%, not at about 80%.
- **sol-002 (L-002 gen 1, T-008):** I confirm never_asked. No request was ever sent; a single turn jumped from under 80% to over kill_pct.
- Together the two kills are a pattern: on this workload, single turns grow context by more than the handoff-to-kill gap, probably because whole materials files are read in one turn.
- Recommendations for the next run:
  1. Seed handoff_pct at 70 instead of 80. This addresses both kills.
  2. Consider kill_grace_turns 3.
  3. In the solver prompt, tell agents to read large materials with offset/limit rather than whole files.
- **Pack and verifier:**
  - T-005 does not say how to count years_between. The verifier wants calendar-year subtraction (2), and a careful solver reasonably computed complete years (1). Next run's task text should say "1855 minus 1853" or "calendar-year difference".
  - T-007's grader wants the word "michaelmas", which the task text never asks for. Either say "give the reopening date as the source names it" or drop that keyword group.
- The handoff prompt worked: seq 22 has every heading and is useful. The successes were not limited by prompt quality.

## For the operator
- The run succeeded: 8 of 8 done, mean 0.946, no blocked tasks, no duplicates.
- Two items to consider at leisure:
  1. Seed handoff_pct at 70 next run (2 kills of 5 successions; both kills came from a single turn jumping past the gap between handoff_pct and kill_pct).
  2. Fix the ambiguous task text for T-005 years_between and T-007 "michaelmas".
- Votes cast after the solvers have exited carry zero weight. If supervisor votes in a final round are meant to shape the next run's board, that is a harness design question.
- No ping sent.
